flows:
Navigate to https://revoke.cash then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
On the Revoke.cash home page, find the search bar and type the public example address 'vitalik.eth', then submit the search (press Enter or click the search button).
Never press 'Revoke', 'Connect Wallet', or any button that approves, confirms, or moves funds.
Assert that the page now shows the entered address (e.g. 'vitalik.eth' or its 0x address) and that a list or section of token approvals is visible or loading for that address.
